name: Intel Arc Pro B50 GPU datasheet (v1.0)
notes: Vendor datasheet v1.0, 'Intel Arc Pro B50 GPU Data Sheet', copyright 2025, fetched as a PDF. Spec table transcribed verbatim: 16 GB GDDR6, 128-bit, 224 GB/s, 70 W total board power, PCIe Gen 5.0 x16 (x8 electrical), 16 Xe-HPG cores, 128 XMX engines, 16 RT units, 170 TOPS INT8 dense, up to 10.65 TFLOPS FP32. Footnote 1 defines the 170 TOPS as peak throughput running XMX workloads with INT8 datatype and dense models. A later copy of the same sheet is at https://www.intel.com/content/dam/www/central-libraries/us/en/documents/2026-03/datasheet-b50-gpu.pdf and prints the identical table; the newsroom PDF is the one cited because it served without gating.
